integrity: Analytic topology, integration and optimization proofs; numerically corroborated by a standalone Python/SciPy checker. No claim of external certification or independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Only unit-radius circular-profile spherical tori, unoriented affine motion-invariant hitting-hyperplane sampling, and generic sections. The optimum is within the one-parameter family. The asymptotic is first-order in dimension; unrelated rotational f-minimal tori and arbitrary meridians are not covered. In dimension three the topology probabilities were known. Unindexed prior stereological theorems may exist.
title: Gaussian-optimal Crofton ball sections of higher-dimensional spherical tori
